subject.title: fix(memory): report indexed vector store in status

question: Should plain `memory status` treat persisted `vectorDims` from a prior successful index as enough to report builtin `Vector store: ready`, while `--deep` remains the live sqlite-vec probe?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and tested, but it changes the user-visible meaning of fast status versus live readiness and should not be accepted by automation alone.

options.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
options.body: Land this PR with `vectorDims` as the fast status signal and keep `--deep` for live sqlite-vec availability proof.

options.title: Require Live-Probe Wording
options.body: Revise the status output to separate prior indexed-vector state from current-process vector-store loadability before merge.

options.title: Pause For A Different Contract
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and redirect the PR if maintainers want `Vector store: ready` to mean only live store loadability.

recommendation.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
recommendation.body: Land this PR with `vectorDims` as the fast status signal and keep `--deep` for live sqlite-vec availability proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest history owner for the memory-core manager and status paths touched by the PR.
